Back of a length from Springer, pitching outside off stump once again. Andrew moves onto the back foot and pulls for 1 run.
On a good length, pitching outside off stump once again. Gous gets on the front foot and edges behind point on the off side for 1 run.
Back of a length, pitching outside off stump once more. Andrew moves onto the back foot and plays a defensive stroke for 1 run.
On a good length, outside off once more. Gous pushes forward and drives for a single run.
Good length from Springer, outside off stump once more. Andrew pushes forward and punches a drive for a single run on the off side.
CHANCE! Pitched up, outside off once again. Gous moves onto the front foot and drives for 1 run. A run out chance but ST LUCIA KINGS survive the attempt from Allen's throw.
Full ball, outside off once more. Andrew pushes forward and drives
On a good length, outside off once more. Gous pushes forward and outside edges for a single run on the off side.
On a good length, outside off again. Gous gets on the front foot and outside edges
Full ball, outside off again. Gous pushes forward and eases a drive on the off side for a couple of runs.
SIX! Pitched up, pitching outside off. Gous pushes forward and drives on the off side for a half dozen runs.
Full, on a good line once again. Andrew gets forward and drives for a run.
Cornwall comes over the wicket to Andrew. Good line and length. Andrew gets forward and glances for one run on the leg side.

commentary.label: W
commentary.commentary: OUT! Cornwall gets one through! Around the wicket to Auguste, pitched up, pitching outside off stump again. He moves onto the front foot and edges, the stumps are disturbed, and Auguste has to depart
Cornwall now coming over the wicket. Back of a length from Cornwall, outside off. Gous moves onto the back foot and drives for 1 run.
Good length, outside off. Auguste moves down the pitch and inside edges behind square for a run.
Cornwall now coming around the wicket to Auguste. Good length, pitching near leg stump and angled across. Auguste gets on the back foot, and is hit on the pads while trying a glance
Good length, pitching outside off. Gous rocks back and drives for a single run.
Short of a length, on leg stump and angling across the batter. Auguste steps back and punches a drive through the off side for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Full, pitching outside leg and angled across Auguste. He pushes forward and plays a sweep behind square for four runs.
Usama Mir pitches one up, pitching outside off. Gous gets forward and drives through the off side for one run.
Back of a length, pitching outside off. Gous moves onto the back foot and inside edges onto the pads while trying a drive
FOUR! Short of a length, pitching outside off. Gous rocks back and plays a cut for 4 runs back behind point.
Full ball, on a good line. Auguste gets on the front foot and eases a drive through the on side field for 1 run.
Good length from Joseph, outside off stump once again. Gous gets forward and edges
Back of a length, outside off again. Gous moves onto the back foot and late cuts
FOUR! Good length, outside off stump. Gous gets on the front foot and drives behind point on the off side for 4 runs.
Back of a length, on line. Auguste rocks back and drives averagely for a run.
Back of a length, outside off stump. Auguste gets on the back foot and cuts
Back of a length from Joseph, pitching on a good line. Auguste gets on the back foot and plays a pull for a couple of runs.
SIX! Short of a length, outside off stump. Gous goes back and lifts a pull for 6 runs.
FOUR! Full toss, pitching on leg and angling across the batter. Gous gets on the front foot and plays a flick for four runs.
Back of a length from Allen, pitching outside off stump. Gous moves onto the back foot and cuts
FOUR! Good length, outside off stump. Auguste creates room and eases a drive for 4 runs.
Length ball, outside off. Auguste gets forward and drives down the ground for a pair of runs.
Back of a length from Seales, pitching outside off stump. Auguste gets on the back foot but swings and misses while trying to play a cut
Short of a length, pitching on a good line. Auguste gets on the back foot and drives
Full ball, pitching outside off stump. Auguste moves onto the front foot but swings and misses while attempting to play a drive
Length ball, pitching outside off stump. Auguste pushes forward but decides to let it pass through to the keeper
Back of a length from Allen, pitching outside off stump. Auguste gets on the back foot and punches a drive through the off side field for one run.
Back of a length from Allen, pitching outside off stump. Auguste rocks back and drives poorly
Short of a length, outside off. Auguste moves onto the back foot and drives sloppily
Back of a length, pitching outside off stump. Auguste moves onto the back foot and drives averagely
Allen comes over the wicket. Back of a length, outside off again. Auguste moves onto the back foot but swings and misses while trying to play a drive

commentary.label: W
commentary.commentary: OUT! Allen gets the wicket! Allen pitches one up, outside off. Pooran pushes forward and drives, but is spectacularly caught by Cornwall
Good line and length. Pooran pushes forward and outside edges behind point for one run.
FOUR! Good length, outside off. Pooran gets on the front foot and eases a drive on the off side for 4 runs.
On a good length, pitching outside off. Gous gets forward and outside edges for a single run back behind point.
Back of a length from Seales, pitching outside off stump once more. Pooran gets on the back foot and slices a late cut for a single run.
And again! Short of a length, outside off once again. Pooran goes back and outside edges for four runs back behind point.
FOUR! Back of a length, outside off. Pooran moves onto the back foot and cuts for 4 runs back behind point.
Good line and length from Allen. Gous moves onto the front foot and drives
Length ball, pitching outside off once more. Gous moves onto the back foot and drives
FOUR! Length ball, outside off. Gous moves onto the back foot and eases a drive through the off side field for four runs.
Pitching on a good line and length. Gous gets forward and punches a drive
Good length, pitching outside off. Gous moves onto the front foot and drives
And another! Pitching on a good line and length again. Gous goes back and drives through the leg side field for 4 runs.
